units.source_text: 本来，直到昨天，只要一想起这样的风景，胸口就像要吐一样的难受。

en.t: Originally, until yesterday, just thinking of a scene like that made his chest feel sick, as if he were about to vomit.

units.source_text: 事实上，对待明信片推销员那样的诈骗犯，最终还是会大发雷霆，觉得那是个早就为其准备好了的圈套。

en.t: In fact, when dealing with a swindler like a postcard salesman, he would still end up flying into a rage, feeling that it was a trap that had been prepared for him long in advance.
